style_anchor: Flat 2D vector illustration with clean bold outlines, simple friendly facial features, minimal shading with subtle gradients, muted palette of navy blue, slate grey, khaki and soft brown, vibrant gold used only for money and wealth, red used only for debt, uncluttered stylized background, soft atmospheric lighting, widescreen composition, no text
